steps.en: Add the core package to a strict TypeScript project
steps.zh: 在开了 strict 的 TypeScript 项目里装上核心包

steps.en: Write the logic as a generator; fail by yielding a tagged error instead of throwing
steps.zh: 把逻辑写成生成器，出错时 yield 带标签的错误而不是 throw

steps.en: Put each outside dependency behind a service and give it a layer that builds it
steps.zh: 把每个外部依赖收进一个服务，再写一个负责构造它的 layer

steps.en: The types now list every unhandled error and every service still missing, so tsc flags the gaps
steps.zh: 类型里列出还没处理的错误和还没提供的服务，漏了 tsc 就报错

steps.en: Hand the finished program to the runtime at the process entrypoint
steps.zh: 在进程入口把写好的程序交给运行时

steps.en: Runs it on fibers, and on SIGINT / SIGTERM interrupts them so cleanup code still runs
steps.zh: 用纤程执行，收到 SIGINT／SIGTERM 时中断纤程，清理代码照样跑完

value.en: Failure modes and dependencies are checked by the compiler, and cancellation and shutdown are handled for you instead of by hand-written try/finally
value.zh: 失败方式和依赖由编译器检查，取消与退出由运行时处理，不用再手写 try/finally
